title.zh: 枪支、爆炸物与武器管制（爆炸物前体处置——类别执照）命令 2025
title.en: Guns, Explosives and Weapons Control (Explosive Precursor Disposal — Class Licence) Order 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 7 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Guns, Explosives and Weapons Control (Explosive Precursor Disposal — Class Licence) Order 2025 and comes into operation on 1 July 2025.

3.—(1) This Order does not extend to a person who is exempt by or under section 87 or 88 of the Act.
(2) The application of paragraph 4 or 5 to a person is subject to section 66(1) and (2)(c) of the Act.

heading.en: Licensee to store, manufacture or supply explosive precursor is class licensee for its disposal
How long to keep records required

text.en: 7. For the purpose of section 61(2)(a) of the Act, a class licensee by virtue of paragraph 4 must keep and retain a record for at least 3 years after the date the record was made.
